data.title: Bitcoin plunges below $70,000 as liquidations reach $622M
data.description: Bitcoin slipped under $70,000, and the traders who borrowed to bet on it going higher paid for it. Crypto liquidations hit $622 million in a span of just four hours.The drop sent Bitcoin to an intraday low of $68,943 on November 13, 2026. It later steadied around $69,297, leaving it down 6% over 24…
